sentences.text: Prognathodon species are characterized by robust, conical teeth that have blunt, serrated edges and smooth enamel.
The largest known tooth crowns of the species P. lutugini reach up to 5.5 cm in height and 2.5 cm in width at the base.
A crescent-shaped tail fluke in Prognathodon indicates convergent evolution with ichthyosaurs, metriorhynchid thalattosuchians and whales.
Its type specimen was recovered from the Méndez Shale in Mexico.
Prognathodon cipactli is recognized as a valid taxon.
It belongs to the subfamily Mosasaurinae, a group of mosasaurs.
Early researchers such as Louis Dollo originally grouped Prognathodon with Platecarpus in a “microrhynchous” group based on rostrum and quadrate features.
Prognathodon cipactli lived during the Late Cretaceous Maastrichtian age.
Fossils of Prognathodon have been found in deposits ranging from the Campanian to the Maastrichtian across the Middle East, Europe, New Zealand, Africa and North America.
The genus Prognathodon is widely considered to be paraphyletic because of incomplete specimens and uncertain early Campanian records.
